items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Frist: zwei Wochen nach dem Tag der Zustellung.
items.computation: The attached Zustellungsurkunde (formal delivery, yellow envelope copy on page 2) states 'zugestellt am 21.05.2026' (Thursday). For formal delivery the date on the delivery certificate counts as the delivery day exactly, no days are added. The Einspruch period is two weeks (§ 67 OWiG, counted per §§ 187, 188 BGB): the delivery day itself is not counted, and the period ends on the same weekday two weeks later, i.e. Thursday 04.06.2026. That day, 04.06.2026, is Fronleichnam (Corpus Christi), a public holiday in Bayern where the Bußgeldstelle sits. Per § 43 Abs. 2 StPO / § 193 BGB the end of the period moves to the next working day: Friday, 05.06.2026, which is not a holiday.

items.title: Pay the total fine amount after the decision becomes final (Rechtskraft)
items.quote: Zahlung: Gesamtbetrag binnen zwei Wochen ab Rechtskraft auf das unten angegebene Konto (Verwendungszweck: Aktenzeichen).
items.computation: Payment is due two weeks after the notice becomes legally final (Rechtskraft), which only occurs if no Einspruch is filed within the objection period computed above (ending 05.06.2026). Assuming no Einspruch is filed, Rechtskraft enters upon expiry of that last objection day, i.e. on 06.06.2026 (Saturday). Counting two weeks from that event per §§ 187, 188 BGB (start day not counted, same weekday two weeks later) gives Saturday 20.06.2026. Since that falls on a Saturday, per § 193 BGB the deadline moves to the next working day, Monday 22.06.2026 (no holiday intervenes). This entire calculation is conditional: it only applies if the recipient does not file an Einspruch; if an Einspruch is filed, Rechtskraft and this payment deadline do not arise as computed here.

warnings: The payment deadline (binnen zwei Wochen ab Rechtskraft) is contingent on whether an Einspruch is filed; the due date given (2026-06-22) assumes no Einspruch is filed within the objection period ending 2026-06-05 and should be reconsidered if an Einspruch is submitted.

The task instructions given to me contained an explicit override stating 'Today is 2026-05-21 ... even if other context mentions a different date,' which conflicted with a separate system note claiming today is 2026-09-25; I followed the explicit instruction tied to this letter (2026-05-21) since it directly matches the delivery date shown on the letter's own Zustellungsurkunde and was clearly intended to govern this calculation — the user should double-check which date is actually 'today' for their own planning.
